title: Envelope Guide request, schemaVersion 1
description: One request object writes one PDF at <output>. An array of request objects is a batch: <output> is a folder and each request writes its own PDF into it. Keys not listed are rejected (error code unknown_key). Text longer than its limit is cut with a warning (field_truncated).

schemaVersion.description: Optional. When present it must be 1.

output.description: Batch only: the file name for this sheet inside the output folder. Default envelope-NNN.pdf, NNN being the request's position (from 001).

envelope.description: The older ids dl-din-a and dl-din-b are still accepted (with a warning) and mean dl-din-5008-b.

senderLine.description: The small return address line printed inside the window above the address.

addressTo.description: The addressee, a string with newlines or a list of lines; 2000 characters at most once joined.

showGuides.description: Print the window outline and full-width fold lines.

path.description: A PNG or JPEG of at most 4 MB inside the base folder (the request file's folder, or --base-dir).

sizeMm.description: Values outside 8 to 30 are set to the nearest limit with a warning.
